// Runtime assertions for receive operations that share a message type.
// Dropped into the tmp module's sharedmsgqueuev1 package next to the
// generated file.

package sharedmsgqueuev1

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
)

type recordingTransport struct {
	queue   string
	keys    []string
	handler func(ctx context.Context, routingKey string, body []byte) error
}

func (r *recordingTransport) Subscribe(_ context.Context, queueName string, bindingKeys []string,
	handler func(ctx context.Context, routingKey string, body []byte) error) error {
	r.queue, r.keys, r.handler = queueName, bindingKeys, handler
	return nil
}

type auditRecorder struct{ got []AuditEvent }

func (a *auditRecorder) HandleAuditEvent(_ context.Context, msg AuditEvent) error {
	a.got = append(a.got, msg)
	return nil
}

// One consumer type serves both the shared queue and the archive queue.
var (
	_ AuditLogHandler   = (*auditRecorder)(nil)
	_ AuditEventHandler = (*auditRecorder)(nil)
)

func TestSubscribeAuditLog_BothKeysReachOneHandler(t *testing.T) {
	tr := &recordingTransport{}
	rec := &auditRecorder{}
	if err := NewSubscriber(tr).SubscribeAuditLog(context.Background(), rec); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if tr.queue != "audit-log" {
		t.Errorf("queue = %q, want audit-log", tr.queue)
	}
	if len(tr.keys) != 2 || tr.keys[0] != "orders.cancelled" || tr.keys[1] != "orders.created" {
		t.Errorf("binding keys = %v, want [orders.cancelled orders.created]", tr.keys)
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"orders.created", "orders.cancelled"} {
		body := []byte(`{"id":"` + key + `","action":"audit"}`)
		if err := tr.handler(context.Background(), key, body); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("deliver on %s: %v", key, err)
		}
	}
	if len(rec.got) != 2 || rec.got[0].ID != "orders.created" || rec.got[1].ID != "orders.cancelled" {
		t.Errorf("handler got %+v, want one event per key in delivery order", rec.got)
	}
}

func TestSubscribeAuditLog_UnknownKeyAndBadBodyAreDropped(t *testing.T) {
	tr := &recordingTransport{}
	if err := NewSubscriber(tr).SubscribeAuditLog(context.Background(), &auditRecorder{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := tr.handler(context.Background(), "orders.deleted", []byte(`{"id":"1","action":"audit"}`)); !errors.Is(err, ErrDrop) {
		t.Errorf("unknown routing key: err = %v, want ErrDrop", err)
	}
	if err := tr.handler(context.Background(), "orders.created", []byte(`not json`)); !errors.Is(err, ErrDrop) {
		t.Errorf("malformed body: err = %v, want ErrDrop", err)
	}
}

func TestSubscribeAuditEvent_ArchiveQueue(t *testing.T) {
	tr := &recordingTransport{}
	rec := &auditRecorder{}
	if err := NewSubscriber(tr).SubscribeAuditEvent(context.Background(), rec); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if tr.queue != "audit-archive" || len(tr.keys) != 1 || tr.keys[0] != "orders.archived" {
		t.Errorf("queue = %q, keys = %v; want audit-archive bound to orders.archived", tr.queue, tr.keys)
	}
	if err := tr.handler(context.Background(), "orders.archived", []byte(`{"id":"a1","action":"archive"}`)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(rec.got) != 1 || rec.got[0].ID != "a1" {
		t.Errorf("handler got %+v, want the archived event", rec.got)
	}
}
